productArea.name: Repository discovery
productArea.scope: Find repositories through Explore, dashboard, user, and organization inventories using search, topic and visibility filters, sorting, pagination, and repository cards. Opening a repository is included only to check navigation, leaving its features and creation to their own areas.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Explore then Repositories and use its search, filters, and sorting.
Use the signed-in dashboard repository inventory and its search and filters.
Open the user profile and inspect its repository inventory.
Open an organization you can access and inspect its repository inventory and dashboard. Create a disposable organization if none exists.
